steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dance terminology is the specialist vocabulary used to describe, analyse and evaluate movement accurately | Key Fact: Action content refers to what the body does: travel, turn, jump, gesture, stillness, transfer of weight | Key Fact: Dynamic content describes how the body moves: fast/slow, sudden/sustained, strong/light, direct/indirect | Key Fact: Spatial content describes where the body moves: levels, directions, pathways, formations, personal and general space

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dance terminology &amp; action words, and one past-paper question.
